description: Wind, Tide, and Sea State forecast data for Manson Construction locations (Manson Vermilion). Customer-facing dashboard.

panels.description: Wind speed forecast with predicted wind direction on the right y-axis.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    forecastdtutc AS "time",
    windspdmean AS windspdmean,
    windspdlb AS windspdlb,
    windspdub AS windspdub,
    winddirmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
    AND model = 'wind_nbm'
    AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT s.startdt FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT startdt
        FROM forecast_data
        WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
          AND locname = '$location'
          AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
          AND model = 'wind_nbm'
          AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
          AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY startdt DESC
        LIMIT 3
      ) s
      WHERE (
        SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
        WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
          AND model = 'wind_nbm'
          AND locname = '$location'
          AND startdt = s.startdt
          AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
          AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
      ) >= $__timeTo()
      ORDER BY s.startdt DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT
  src."time",
  src.windspdmean,
  src.windspdlb,
  src.windspdub,
  w.v1_s0 AS winddirmean,
  w.v1_sm1 AS winddirmean_sm1,
  w.v1_sp1 AS winddirmean_sp1,
  (MOD(MOD(src.winddirmean::numeric, 360) + 360, 360))::float AS winddir_tooltip
FROM src
JOIN public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time" ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirmean ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w USING ("time")
ORDER BY src."time"

panels.description: Maximum probability of lightning (thunderstorm) in the next 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  MAX(pot) AS pot
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  pot IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
  AND model = 'wind_nbm'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Max Prob of Thunderstorms (24h)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp) * 1000 AS peak_time
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  pot IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
  AND model = 'wind_nbm'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY pot DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.description: Significant Wave Height (max over next 6 hours).

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT MAX(startdt) AS startdt
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE htsgw IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(MAX(htsgw)::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM forecast_data
WHERE htsgw IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
  AND startdt = (SELECT startdt FROM selected_run)

panels.description: Tide height forecast with upper/lower bounds for the selected location.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  tidemean_display,
  tideub_display,
  tidelb_display
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE
  tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
  AND model = 'tide_blend'
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT s.startdt FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT startdt
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
        AND model = 'tide_blend'
        AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY startdt DESC
      LIMIT 24
    ) s
    WHERE (
      SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
      WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
        AND model = 'tide_blend'
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND startdt = s.startdt
        AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
    ) >= $__timeTo()
    ORDER BY s.startdt DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tide Forecast

panels.description: Current tide height at the selected location.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT s.startdt AS max_startdt FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT startdt
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
      AND model = 'tide_blend'
      AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY startdt DESC
    LIMIT 24
  ) s
  WHERE (
    SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
    WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
      AND model = 'tide_blend'
      AND startdt = s.startdt
      AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
  ) >= $__timeTo()
  AND (
    SELECT MIN(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
    WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
      AND model = 'tide_blend'
      AND startdt = s.startdt
      AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
  ) <= s.startdt + INTERVAL '24 hours'
  ORDER BY s.startdt DESC
  LIMIT 1
), before_pt AS (
  SELECT timestamp, tidemean_display
  FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
  WHERE tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
    AND model = 'tide_blend'
    AND startdt = (SELECT max_startdt FROM latest_run)
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
), after_pt AS (
  SELECT timestamp, tidemean_display
  FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
  WHERE tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
    AND model = 'tide_blend'
    AND startdt = (SELECT max_startdt FROM latest_run)
    AND timestamp > NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY timestamp ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN b.timestamp IS NOT NULL AND a.timestamp IS NOT NULL
      THEN b.tidemean_display + (a.tidemean_display - b.tidemean_display)
        * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ - b.timestamp))
        / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.timestamp - b.timestamp)), 0)
    ELSE COALESCE(b.tidemean_display, a.tidemean_display)
  END AS tidemean_display
FROM (SELECT 1) _
LEFT JOIN before_pt b ON true
LEFT JOIN after_pt a ON true

panels.title: Current Tide

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT s.startdt AS max_startdt FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT startdt
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
      AND model = 'tide_blend'
      AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY startdt DESC
    LIMIT 24
  ) s
  WHERE (
    SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
    WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
      AND model = 'tide_blend'
      AND startdt = s.startdt
      AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
  ) >= $__timeTo()
  AND (
    SELECT MIN(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
    WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
      AND model = 'tide_blend'
      AND startdt = s.startdt
      AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
  ) <= s.startdt + INTERVAL '24 hours'
  ORDER BY s.startdt DESC
  LIMIT 1
), before_pt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname)
    locname, datum, timestamp, tidemean_display
  FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
  WHERE tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
    AND model = 'tide_blend'
    AND startdt = (SELECT max_startdt FROM latest_run)
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, timestamp DESC
), after_pt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname)
    locname, timestamp, tidemean_display
  FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
  WHERE tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
    AND model = 'tide_blend'
    AND startdt = (SELECT max_startdt FROM latest_run)
    AND timestamp > NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, timestamp ASC
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT g2.metadata->'display_name_overrides'->>b.locname FROM public.customer_groups g2 WHERE g2.group_id = 'grp_manson' AND g2.metadata ? 'display_name_overrides'), b.locname) AS "Location",
  NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AS "Current Time",
  CASE
    WHEN b.timestamp IS NOT NULL AND a.timestamp IS NOT NULL
      THEN b.tidemean_display + (a.tidemean_display - b.tidemean_display)
        * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ - b.timestamp))
        / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.timestamp - b.timestamp)), 0)
    ELSE COALESCE(b.tidemean_display, a.tidemean_display)
  END AS "Predicted Value",
  COALESCE(b.datum, '') AS "Datum"
FROM before_pt b
FULL OUTER JOIN after_pt a ON b.locname = a.locname
ORDER BY "Location"

SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "Date (${__timezone})",
  tidemean_display AS "Predicted Value",
  tideub_display AS "Tide Upper Bound",
  tidelb_display AS "Tide Lower Bound"
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE
  tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
  AND model = 'tide_blend'
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT s.startdt FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT startdt
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = 'grp_manson'
        AND model = 'tide_blend'
        AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY startdt DESC
      LIMIT 24
    ) s
    WHERE (
      SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
      WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
        AND model = 'tide_blend'
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND startdt = s.startdt
        AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
    ) >= $__timeTo()
    AND (
      SELECT MIN(forecastdtutc) FROM forecast_data
      WHERE group_id = 'grp_manson'
        AND model = 'tide_blend'
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND startdt = s.startdt
        AND tidemean IS NOT NULL
    ) <= s.startdt + INTERVAL '24 hours'
    ORDER BY s.startdt DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY 1
